messages.confirmShareGame: This QR Code can be scanned by any other mobile device to transfer this game onto a different device.  Just follow these simple steps:
messages.confirmShareGame_step1: Open scorespad in a different device, it can be a computer, tablet or phone.
messages.confirmShareGame_step2: Click on the big + buttons appearing at the bottom right of the screen.
messages.confirmShareGame_step3: Once the dialog is opened, you can press the "Scan" button in order to scan this code.
messages.confirmShareGame_step4: Once scanned, scorespad will synchronize the game into a different device and you're done.
